'''Gwellis Bagnoro''' was a mysterious [[Onodone]] [[Gender|male]] who rarely talked about his past. He worked as an expert [[Forger (profession)|forger]] specializing in transit documents thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> He was present in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]] in [[34 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Um...Gwellis? You in here? It's Han. Han Solo. From Corellia.|Han Solo|<ref name="Droid Hunters">[[Star Wars Adventures Free Comic Book Day 2019|''Star Wars Adventures'' Free Comic Book Day 2019]]</ref>}}
Gwellis Bagnoro was [[Reproduction|born]] on [[Onod I]].<ref name="Datapad" /> He was a mysterious [[Onodone]] who rarely talked about his past.<ref name="TFAVD" /> At some point, Bagnoro met [[Han Solo]].<ref name="Droid Hunters" />

===Life on Ogem===
{{Quote|I better look after this after this until Gwellis wakes up. See you around Gwarm.|Han Solo to Gwarm|<ref name="Droid Hunters" />}}
[[File:GwellisBagnoro-SWAFCBD2019.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Gwellis Bagnoro on Ogem]]
At some point before the [[Galactic Civil War]], Bagnoro and his protective pet [[barghest]], [[Izby]], lived in a [[cave]] on the [[planet]] [[Ogem]]. On Ogem, Bagnoro had the third and final droid that contained the treasure of [[Rane Mahal]].<ref name="Droid Hunters" />

While Bagnoro was sleeping, [[Gwarm]] stole his valuable droid. Before he could escape, Han Solo stole it from Gwarm when Izby attacked him.<ref name="Droid Hunters" />

===New Republic Era===
Thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], Bagnoro became a [[Forger (profession)|forger]] specializing in transit documents.<ref name="TFAVD" />

[[File:GwellisBgnoroIzby-BaseSeries3.png|thumb|right|250px|Bagnoro with his pet, Izby]]
Bagnoro was also present in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]]<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> with his pet barghest [[Izby]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> when the [[smuggler]] Han Solo arrived with the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]], the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and the ex-[[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]]. Shortly after Solo's arrival, the [[First Order]] destroyed the planets of the [[Hosnian system]] with their [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]], an event which was visible from Takodana's surface and so drew many of the patrons of the castle out to watch in horror. The castle itself was then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the forces of the First Order.<ref name="TFA" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gwellis Bagnoro was created for [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], where he appeared briefly as a background character in Maz Kanata's castle.<ref name="TFA" /> The character was first revealed to the public through an exclusive [http://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2015/05/star-wars-force-awakens-photos article] on the website of [[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair|''Vanity Fair'']] in [[May]] [[2015]],<ref name="Vanity Fair">{{WebCite|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2015/05/star-wars-force-awakens-photos|text=Adam Driver and Lupita Nyong'o's Characters Revealed in Exclusive Star Wars: The Force Awakens Photos|author=Leibovitz, Annie|date=2015-05-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]]|archivedate=20150504170503}}</ref> seven months before the film's release. Neither the article nor the film identified the character, but his name was revealed in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released the same day as the film.<ref name="TFAVD" /> Bagnoro was portrayed by an uncredited [[Arti Shah]].
